passages.text: Then the man led me out northward into the outer court, and he brought me to the group of chambers opposite the temple courtyard and the outer wall on the north side.
passages.sermon:
A man guided me.
He led me out toward the north.
He took me into the outer court.
He brought me to a group of rooms.
These rooms stood opposite the temple courtyard.
They also stood opposite the outer wall.
These rooms were on the north side.
passages.original: וַיּוֹצִאֵ֗נִי אֶל־ הֶֽחָצֵר֙ הַחִ֣יצוֹנָ֔ה הַדֶּ֖רֶךְ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַצָּפ֑וֹן וַיְבִאֵ֣נִי אֶל־ הַלִּשְׁכָּ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר נֶ֧גֶד הַגִּזְרָ֛ה וַאֲשֶֽׁר־ נֶ֥גֶד הַבִּנְיָ֖ן אֶל־ הַצָּפֽוֹן׃

passages.text: The building with the door facing north was a hundred cubits long and fifty cubits wide.
passages.sermon: The building stood with its door facing north.\r\nThe building was one hundred cubits long.\r\nThe building was fifty cubits wide.
passages.original: אֶל־ פְּנֵי־ אֹ֙רֶךְ֙ אַמּ֣וֹת הַמֵּאָ֔ה פֶּ֖תַח הַצָּפ֑וֹן וְהָרֹ֖חַב חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים אַמּֽוֹת׃

passages.text: Gallery faced gallery in three levels opposite the twenty cubits that belonged to the inner court and opposite the pavement that belonged to the outer court.
passages.sermon:
There were galleries in the temple complex.
Each gallery faced another gallery.
There were three levels of galleries.
These galleries stood opposite the twenty cubits of the inner court.
They also stood opposite the pavement of the outer court.
passages.original: נֶ֣גֶד הָֽעֶשְׂרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁר֙ לֶחָצֵ֣ר הַפְּנִימִ֔י וְנֶ֣גֶד רִֽצְפָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר לֶחָצֵ֣ר הַחִֽיצוֹנָ֑ה אַתִּ֥יק אֶל־ פְּנֵֽי־ אַתִּ֖יק בַּשְּׁלִשִֽׁים׃

passages.text: In front of the chambers was an inner walkway ten cubits wide and a hundred cubits long. Their doors were on the north.
passages.sermon:
The chambers had an inner walkway in front of them.
This walkway was ten cubits wide.
The walkway was a hundred cubits long.
The doors of the chambers faced north.
passages.original: וְלִפְנֵ֨י הַלְּשָׁכ֜וֹת מַהֲלַךְ֩ עֶ֨שֶׂר אַמּ֥וֹת רֹ֙חַב֙ אֶל־ הַפְּנִימִ֔ית דֶּ֖רֶךְ אַמָּ֣ה אֶחָ֑ת וּפִתְחֵיהֶ֖ם לַצָּפֽוֹן׃

passages.text: Now the upper chambers were smaller because the galleries took more space from the chambers on the lower and middle floors of the building.
passages.sermon:
The upper chambers were smaller.
The building had three levels.
Galleries took space from the lower chambers.
Galleries also took space from the middle chambers.
The upper chambers lost space because of these galleries.
passages.original: וְהַלְּשָׁכ֥וֹת הָעֶלְיוֹנֹ֖ת קְצֻר֑וֹת כִּֽי־ יוֹכְל֨וּ אַתִּיקִ֜ים מֵהֵ֗נָה מֵֽהַתַּחְתֹּנ֛וֹת וּמֵהַתִּֽכֹנ֖וֹת בִּנְיָֽן׃

passages.text: For they were arranged in three stories, and unlike the courts, they had no pillars. So the upper chambers were set back further than the lower and middle floors.
passages.sermon:
The chambers had three stories.
The chambers did not have pillars.
The courts had pillars, but the chambers did not.
Because there were no pillars, the upper chambers were set back farther than the lower and middle chambers.
The upper chambers were farther from the ground than the lower and middle chambers.
passages.original: כִּ֤י מְשֻׁלָּשׁוֹת֙ הֵ֔נָּה וְאֵ֤ין לָהֶן֙ עַמּוּדִ֔ים כְּעַמּוּדֵ֖י הַחֲצֵר֑וֹת עַל־ כֵּ֣ן נֶאֱצַ֗ל מֵהַתַּחְתּוֹנ֛וֹת וּמֵהַתִּֽיכֹנ֖וֹת מֵהָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: An outer wall in front of the chambers was fifty cubits long and ran parallel to the chambers and the outer court.
passages.sermon:
The temple had chambers.
A wall stood outside these chambers.
This wall was in front of the chambers.
The wall ran along the outer courtyard.
The wall was parallel to the chambers.
The wall was fifty cubits long.
passages.original: וְגָדֵ֤ר אֲשֶׁר־ לַחוּץ֙ לְעֻמַּ֣ת הַלְּשָׁכ֔וֹת דֶּ֛רֶךְ הֶחָצֵ֥ר הַחִֽצוֹנָ֖ה אֶל־ פְּנֵ֣י הַלְּשָׁכ֑וֹת אָרְכּ֖וֹ חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים אַמָּֽה׃

passages.text: For the chambers on the outer court were fifty cubits long, while those facing the temple were a hundred cubits long.
passages.sermon:
The chambers stood in the outer court.
Each chamber in the outer court measured fifty cubits in length.
Other chambers faced the temple.
Each chamber facing the temple measured one hundred cubits in length.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ אֹ֣רֶךְ הַלְּשָׁכ֗וֹת אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֶחָצֵ֥ר הַחִֽצוֹנָ֖ה חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים אַמָּ֑ה וְהִנֵּ֛ה עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י הַהֵיכָ֖ל מֵאָ֥ה אַמָּֽה׃

passages.text: And below these chambers was the entrance on the east side as one enters them from the outer court.
passages.sermon:
There were chambers in the temple complex.
Below these chambers was an entrance.
This entrance was on the east side.
People entered through this entrance from the outer court.
passages.original: וּמִתַּחֲתָה לְּשָׁכוֹת הָאֵ֑לֶּה הַמָּבוֹא מֵֽהַקָּדִ֔ים בְּבֹא֣וֹ לָהֵ֔נָּה מֵֽהֶחָצֵ֖ר הַחִצֹנָֽה׃

passages.text: On the south side along the length of the wall of the outer court were chambers adjoining the courtyard and opposite the building, with a passageway in front of them, just like the chambers that were on the north. They had the same length and width, with similar exits and dimensions.
passages.sermon:
The temple had an outer court.
A wall surrounded this outer court.
On the south side of this wall, there were chambers.
These chambers stood next to the courtyard.
They also stood opposite the building.
A passageway ran in front of these chambers.
This passageway was on the east side.
The chambers on the south side looked like the chambers on the north side.
The chambers on the south side had the same length as those on the north side.
They also had the same width.
All the chambers had similar exits.
All the chambers had similar entrances.
All the chambers had the same design.
passages.original: בְּרֹ֣חַב׀ גֶּ֣דֶר הֶחָצֵ֗ר דֶּ֧רֶךְ הַקָּדִ֛ים אֶל־ פְּנֵ֧י הַגִּזְרָ֛ה וְאֶל־ פְּנֵ֥י הַבִּנְיָ֖ן לְשָׁכֽוֹת׃ וְדֶ֙רֶךְ֙ לִפְנֵיהֶ֔ם כְּמַרְאֵ֣ה הַלְּשָׁכ֗וֹת אֲשֶׁר֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַצָּפ֔וֹן כְּאָרְכָּ֖ן כֵּ֣ן רָחְבָּ֑ן וְכֹל֙ מוֹצָ֣אֵיהֶ֔ן וּכְמִשְׁפְּטֵיהֶ֖ן וּכְפִתְחֵיהֶֽן׃

passages.text: And corresponding to the doors of the chambers that were facing south, there was a door in front of the walkway that was parallel to the wall extending eastward.
passages.sermon:
The chambers had doors that faced south.
There was a door in front of the walkway.
This walkway was parallel to the wall.
The wall extended toward the east.
The door allowed entry from the east side.
passages.original: וּכְפִתְחֵ֣י הַלְּשָׁכ֗וֹת אֲשֶׁר֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַדָּר֔וֹם פֶּ֖תַח בְּרֹ֣אשׁ דָּ֑רֶךְ דֶּ֗רֶךְ בִּפְנֵי֙ הַגְּדֶ֣רֶת הֲגִינָ֔ה דֶּ֥רֶךְ הַקָּדִ֖ים בְּבוֹאָֽן׃

passages.text: Then the man said to me, “The north and south chambers facing the temple courtyard are the holy chambers where the priests who approach the LORD will eat the most holy offerings. There they will place the most holy offerings—the grain offerings, the sin offerings, and the guilt offerings—for the place is holy.
passages.sermon:
A man spoke to me.
He explained the purpose of the chambers.
There are chambers on the north side.
There are chambers on the south side.
These chambers face the temple courtyard.
These chambers are holy.
Priests use these chambers.
These priests come near to the LORD.
These priests eat the most holy offerings in these chambers.
The priests place the most holy offerings there.
They also place the grain offerings there.
They place the sin offerings there.
They place the guilt offerings there.
This place is holy.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֗י לִֽשְׁכ֨וֹת הַצָּפ֜וֹן לִֽשְׁכ֣וֹת הַדָּרוֹם֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֶל־ פְּנֵ֣י הַגִּזְרָה֒ הֵ֣נָּה׀ לִֽשְׁכ֣וֹת הַקֹּ֗דֶשׁ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יֹאכְלוּ־ שָׁ֧ם הַכֹּהֲנִ֛ים אֲשֶׁר־ קְרוֹבִ֥ים לַֽיהוָ֖ה קָדְשֵׁ֣י הַקֳּדָשִׁ֑ים שָׁ֞ם יַנִּ֣יחוּ׀ קָדְשֵׁ֣י הַקֳּדָשִׁ֗ים וְהַמִּנְחָה֙ וְהַחַטָּ֣את וְהָאָשָׁ֔ם כִּ֥י הַמָּק֖וֹם קָדֹֽשׁ׃

passages.text: Once the priests have entered the holy area, they must not go out into the outer court until they have left behind the garments in which they minister, for these are holy. They are to put on other clothes before they approach the places that are for the people.”
passages.sermon:
The priests serve God in the holy area.
The holy area is set apart for God.
When the priests enter the holy area, they wear special garments.
These garments are holy.
The priests must not go out from the holy area to the outer court while wearing these holy garments.
Before they leave the holy area, the priests must take off the holy garments they used for service.
They must leave these garments in the holy area.
Then the priests must put on other clothes.
After that, they may go to the places that are for the people.
passages.original: בְּבֹאָ֣ם הַכֹּהֲנִ֗ים וְלֹֽא־ יֵצְא֤וּ מֵהַקֹּ֙דֶשׁ֙ אֶל־ הֶחָצֵ֣ר הַחִיצוֹנָ֔ה וְשָׁ֞ם יַנִּ֧יחוּ בִגְדֵיהֶ֛ם אֲשֶׁר־ יְשָׁרְת֥וּ בָהֶ֖ן כִּֽי־ קֹ֣דֶשׁ הֵ֑נָּה יִלְבְּשׁוּ בְּגָדִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וְקָרְב֖וּ אֶל־ אֲשֶׁ֥ר לָעָֽם׃

passages.text: Now when the man had finished measuring the interior of the temple area, he led me out by the gate that faced east, and he measured the area all around: With a measuring rod he measured the east side to be five hundred cubits long.
passages.sermon:
A man stood with me.
He finished measuring the inside of the temple area.
He led me out of the temple.
He took me through the gate that faced east.
He measured the area all around the temple.
He used a measuring rod.
He measured the east side.
The east side was five hundred cubits long.
passages.original: וְכִלָּ֗ה אֶת־ מִדּוֹת֙ הַבַּ֣יִת הַפְּנִימִ֔י וְהוֹצִיאַ֙נִי֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַשַּׁ֔עַר אֲשֶׁ֥ר פָּנָ֖יו דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַקָּדִ֑ים וּמְדָד֖וֹ סָבִ֥יב׀ סָבִֽיב׃ מָדַ֛ד ר֥וּחַ הַקָּדִ֖ים בִּקְנֵ֣ה הַמִּדָּ֑ה חֲמֵשׁ־ אֵמוֹת קָנִ֛ים בִּקְנֵ֥ה הַמִּדָּ֖ה סָבִֽיב׃

passages.text: He measured the north side to be five hundred cubits long.
passages.sermon: A man measured the north side of the temple area.\r\nHe used a measuring rod.\r\nThe north side was five hundred cubits long.
passages.original: מָדַ֖ד ר֣וּחַ הַצָּפ֑וֹן חֲמֵשׁ־ מֵא֥וֹת קָנִ֛ים בִּקְנֵ֥ה הַמִּדָּ֖ה סָבִֽיב׃

passages.text: He measured the south side to be five hundred cubits long.
passages.sermon: A man measured the south side of the temple area.\r\nHe used a measuring rod.\r\nThe south side was five hundred cubits long.
passages.original: אֵ֛ת ר֥וּחַ הַדָּר֖וֹם מָדָ֑ד חֲמֵשׁ־ מֵא֥וֹת קָנִ֖ים בִּקְנֵ֥ה הַמִּדָּֽה׃

passages.text: And he came around and measured the west side to be five hundred cubits long.
passages.sermon:
A man measured the temple area.
He went to the west side.
He measured the west side.
The west side was five hundred cubits long.
He used the measuring rod.
passages.original: סָבַ֖ב אֶל־ ר֣וּחַ הַיָּ֑ם מָדַ֛ד חֲמֵשׁ־ מֵא֥וֹת קָנִ֖ים בִּקְנֵ֥ה הַמִּדָּֽה׃

passages.text: So he measured the area on all four sides. It had a wall all around, five hundred cubits long and five hundred cubits wide, to separate the holy from the common.
passages.sermon:
A man measured the area on all four sides.
A wall surrounded the area on every side.
The wall was five hundred cubits long.
The wall was five hundred cubits wide.
The wall separated the holy from the common.
passages.original: לְאַרְבַּ֨ע רוּח֜וֹת מְדָד֗וֹ ח֤וֹמָה לוֹ֙ סָבִ֣יב׀ סָבִ֔יב אֹ֚רֶךְ חֲמֵ֣שׁ מֵא֔וֹת וְרֹ֖חַב חֲמֵ֣שׁ מֵא֑וֹת לְהַבְדִּ֕יל בֵּ֥ין הַקֹּ֖דֶשׁ לְחֹֽל׃
